sources: Taylor polynomials of sine and cosine in Horner form; exact octant and quadrant symmetry (elementary; no external source)
Divergence-theorem volume of a closed triangle mesh and the cross-product area identity (elementary; no external source)
Inscribed regular polygon prisms of the solid cylinder and the annular tube (elementary; no external source)
The Khronos Group, glTF 2.0 Specification (binary glTF container, accessors, buffer views)
Binary STL file layout (80-byte header, uint32 triangle count, float32 normal and vertices, uint16 attribute)

Surface of revolution through a sampled axial radius profile, linear between samples (elementary; the rings are those of geometry_unit_circle and the vertex and face order is that of geometry_primitives)
Closed forms of the conical frustum: volume (pi / 3) (r1^2 + r1 r2 + r2^2) h and lateral area pi (r1 + r2) sqrt((r2 - r1)^2 + h^2) (elementary; no external source)

Solid of revolution whose profile closes on the axis at one or both poles: a pole is one apex vertex and the faces are those of the open primitive with the degenerate ones removed; the frustum closed forms reduce to the cone forms at a pole and are reused unchanged (ADR 0012)
Sphere sampled uniformly in polar angle and its shell as two nested closed surfaces (elementary; no external source)
translation of a vertex stream and equally spaced centres on a circle (elementary; the circle points are those of geometry_unit_circle)

Natural logarithm by exact binary decomposition and the odd series of atanh((m-1)/(m+1)); exponential by the Cody-Waite reduction and the Taylor series; power as exp(y ln x) (elementary; no external source)
W. J. Cody, W. Waite, Software Manual for the Elementary Functions, Prentice-Hall (1980): the split of ln 2 into a high part with trailing zero bits and a low part
NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, 10.2.2: ascending series of J_nu (evaluated in Horner form on x^2/4 with exact integer-quotient coefficients, 30 terms, |x| <= 8)
NIST DLMF 10.21 and OEIS A115368, A115369: the first positive zeros of J0 and J1 as correctly rounded doubles

CadQuery 2.8 documentation (Workplane, Shape.Volume/Area/BoundingBox) and Open CASCADE Technology 7.9 reference (BRepGProp, Bnd_Box): the pinned third-party B-rep kernel that builds the solids; measures checked against the analytic closed forms of the cylinder and the annular tube (elementary; no external source)
Open CASCADE Technology 7.9: STEPControl_Writer and APIHeaderSection_MakeHeader (Part 21 HEADER: FILE_DESCRIPTION, FILE_NAME with time stamp, FILE_SCHEMA); CadQuery 2.8 Assembly export
ISO 10303-21 clear-text encoding: structure taken from the writer output and the OCC documentation (the standard text is not freely available)

Open CASCADE Technology 7.9: BRepMesh_IncrementalMesh (linear and angular deflection) through CadQuery Shape.tessellate; vertex welding by exact coordinate equality into the geometry_mesh_contract kernel
Inscribed-chord volume deficit bound 2 d / r and the inscribed regular polygon area ratio (n / 2 pi) sin(2 pi / n) (elementary; no external source)

A triangle that vertex welding collapses to a repeated index has zero area and is dropped before the mesh contract; its two non-degenerate directed edges are each other's reverse, so no other face's pairing changes (ADR 0012)
Gmsh 4.15.2 reference manual: OpenCASCADE import (model.occ.importShapes), Mesh.MeshSizeMin/Max, Mesh.Algorithm3D, MSH 4.1 ASCII format
Tetrahedron volume |det(v1 - v0, v2 - v0, v3 - v0)| / 6 (elementary; no external source)

Open CASCADE Technology 7.9 through CadQuery 2.8: revolution of a closed polyline about the axis (Workplane.polyline, Workplane.revolve); the profile contract and the closed forms are those of the tier-G1 geometry_profiles kernel

Revolution of a profile that closes on the axis: no axis return point is appended at an end already on it, and the analytic references are the tier-G1 closed forms, a pole contributing no disc (ADR 0012)
Exact solids of revolution of the sphere profile and of the region between two concentric spheres (elementary; no external source)

Composition of the declared bounds of cad_brep_solids (relative measure tolerance against the analytic closed forms) and cad_faceting (the chord deficit bound 2 d / r and the inscribed regular polygon area ratio); no external source
Open CASCADE Technology 7.9 through CadQuery 2.8: Shape.translate (gp_Trsf rigid translation); the ring centres are those of the tier-G1 geometry_placement kernel

Invariance of volume and surface area under a rigid motion (elementary; no external source): the analytic closed forms are carried over, the kernel's own measure of the placed solid is checked against them within the declared tolerance and is not claimed bit-identical to the measure of the source solid

machine_protection.statement: Independent machine-protection systems retain the final veto before any plant actuator path; nothing in this library participates in, or substitutes for, that path, and no kernel reaches any actuator or facility.

non_claims: no solver, controller, dataset, experimental correlation or published artefact; every kernel is a computational prototype of a cited closed form or a standard method
no value describes or validates any real machine; a kernel's presence says nothing about any device's performance
